query:
UPDATE authorization_codes SET
                 code_hash = $2,
                 authorization_request_id = $3,
                 account_id = $4,
                 client_id = $5,
                 sso_session_id = $6,
                 redirect_uri = $7,
                 granted_scopes = $8,
                 pkce_code_challenge = $9,
                 pkce_code_challenge_method = $10,
                 auth_time = $11,
                 expires_at = $12,
                 consumed_at = $13,
                 created_at = $14
               WHERE id = $1
